name: timel.in
description: timel.in — the OpenHistoryMap interactive timeline as a framework-agnostic library (core + React + Angular).

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:react && npm run build:angular
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @openhistorymap/timeline-core && npm run typecheck -w @openhistorymap/timeline-react
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @openhistorymap/timeline-core && npm run clean -w @openhistorymap/timeline-react && npm run clean -w @openhistorymap/timeline-angular
